Qualcomm input boost is explicitly coupled to touchscreen events and cpufreq policy updates.

Candidate0059 MIGT FREQ_QOS activity interferes with Qualcomm touch/input boost timing or adds redundant scheduler/cpufreq work.
Goodix IRQ delivery/affinity/rate is abnormal under Candidate0059.
TouchFeature HwBinder -74 contributes materially to the regression.
